Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract precise numerical data from the search results, instead providing a vague summary with conflicting units (mg/kWh vs g/kWh) and mixing operational and lifecycle figures. This data fabrication/misinterpretation created an incomplete dataset that the Planner could not verify, forcing the team into a loop of redundant searches that never yielded the specific numbers needed to confirm the answer.
